verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own getting-started docs say users manage and action risks in the platform, and a 'Continuous Risk Monitoring' page exists. However, documented risk scoring with thresholds is shown only for the AI Systems module, not for a general risk register. Owner assignment and remediation tasks are likewise documented only for AI governance findings. missing for 10: evidence of a general risk register with scored risks, documented treatment plans, risk owners on register entries, periodic risk review cycles, explicit risk-to-control mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: configure governance, build a security programme, and manage risks for complete compliance readiness
Learn how to assess, score, and manage AI system risk in Sprinto using configurable AI risk factors and automated risk scoring workflows.
